rationale: LAB-01 verified REI on a dedicated server: loads clean, no Matcha conflict, identical recipe counts with and without it. It is also the ONLY viewer with a real 26.2 release, since EMI stops at 1.21.1.
custom_justification: Not applicable. No custom implementation is contemplated.
notes: LAB-01 decided. JEI explicitly REJECTED: it has a 26.2 build but only in beta, and Jade lists it as an optional dependency, so it must be excluded deliberately or the pack ships two viewers.

rationale: LAB-01 verified Jade loads and initialises server-side (CorePlugin, VanillaPlugin, UniversalPlugin) with no Matcha conflict, and ships zero guidebook assets.
companion_role: May expose Field Journal state to the viewer if a clean API exists.
custom_justification: Not applicable.
notes: LAB-01 decided. Its IBlockComponentProvider API is also the identified seam for surfacing Field Journal state without the journal owning the HUD.

rationale: LAB-03 confirmed maintained 26.2 candidates exist. Effortless Building is a PILOT for assisted placement and VeinMiner a PILOT for excavation, both with server-side durability and limits.
companion_role: Possibly a permission or durability policy adapter.
custom_justification: Not applicable at this stage.
notes: LAB-02. Must respect server authority and real material cost.

rationale: LAB-03 selected VeinMiner as the clearest server-side durability, correct-tool, permission and chain-limit implementation. Liteminer needs a client test before it can be compared.
custom_justification: Not applicable.
notes: LAB-02. Check interaction with Matcha tool tiers and durability.

rationale: LAB-04 found Litematica is the strongest existing Ghost Plan implementation: .litematic and .schem support, previews, and material lists. Rebuilding this would be a large graphics project with no design payoff.
custom_justification: Not applicable.
notes: LAB-04: PILOT. Simple Blueprints REJECTED for gating placement behind creative-only setblock. AutoBuild and HoloBuilder NEEDS_MORE_EVIDENCE. Client and multiplayer evidence still required.

rationale: LAB-04 found AutoBuild provides server-side assisted construction on paper but can overreach into printing, with unresolved licence, claim, permission, reach and durability risks. The pack contributes the cost and permission policy, not the placement code.
companion_role: Construction Contract gating, material sourcing, and worker involvement.
custom_justification: Only the contract policy is pack-specific; the placement is not.
notes: LAB-04: not adopted. Construction Contract level remains gated on resolving those risks.

rationale: LAB-05 tested seven food mods and REJECTED every one for the default baseline. Matcha already owns the cooking process, food effects, hunger and healing model, and readable instructions. A second cooking stack would give the player two ovens and duplicate foods, which is the exact duplication the pack exists to avoid.
custom_justification: Not applicable.
notes: LAB-03. Check overlap with Matcha's own extensive food set.

rationale: Effect balance is tuning, and tuning belongs in data where it can be changed without a recompile.
custom_justification: Not applicable.
notes: LAB-03. Matcha already defines hunger and healing behaviour that must be reconciled.

rationale: LAB-06 upheld ADR 0014: the pack depends on a climate ABSTRACTION, not a specific seasons mod. No candidate was added to pack/ directly or indirectly. Homeostatic Seasons is the best 26.2 provider candidate because it boots beside Matcha and leaves the recipe and advancement baseline unchanged.
companion_role: Climate abstraction so pack systems do not hardcode one season mod.
custom_justification: The abstraction is justified; the simulation is not.
notes: LAB-06: PILOT behind the abstraction only. Serene Seasons DEFER (beta, All Rights Reserved, beta GlitchCore dep). Removal is NOT a cosmetic toggle: a provider game rule can survive as an unknown registry key after the jar is removed.

rationale: LAB-06 confirmed the abstraction must expose calendar, transition, weather and temperature. Homeostatic supplies all four, which is what makes it the pilot target.
existing_mod_candidate: adapter over the selected climate provider
companion_role: Adapter over the selected climate mod.
custom_justification: No mod can know what this pack wants to do with weather state.
notes: LAB-06: crop suitability, unknown-crop handling, greenhouse mitigation and the client projection still need a focused ticket before adoption.

rationale: LAB-07 tested seven storage mods and found NONE that indexes arbitrary registered containers server-authoritatively without wireless access or data loss on removal. The prototype code previously classified REPLACE is therefore retained as ADAPT.
custom_justification: Not applicable.
notes: LAB-05. Universal wireless storage is explicitly rejected as a default.

rationale: Pipes and local transport are solved and are core technical-play content.
custom_justification: Not applicable.
notes: LAB-06.

rationale: Cross-settlement freight is a pack-identity system tied to routes, settlements, and registration. No general mod models it.
companion_role: Route validation, shipment state, and delivery.
custom_justification: No maintained mod provides infrastructure-gated freight tied to registered routes.
notes: Requires settlements and routes first. ADR 0012 forbids a magical cross-dimensional warehouse.

rationale: Rail physics is fiddly and well covered. The prototype flagged custom minecart acceleration as a REPLACE candidate.
custom_justification: Not applicable.
notes: LAB-07.

rationale: Earned passenger travel depends on route registration, journey validation, and settlement state, which are pack concepts.
companion_role: Service unlock, scheduling, and journey skipping.
custom_justification: ADR 0031 requires infrastructure-gated travel that no general teleport mod expresses.
notes: Explicitly not a waystone network.

rationale: Rebalancing Elytra is a tuning decision, best expressed through a maintained mod's configuration or a datapack rather than new code.
custom_justification: Not applicable.
notes: LAB-07. ADR 0013 makes the Elytra a glider rather than dominant travel.

rationale: Horse handling and ownership have maintained implementations. Custom generic horse ownership was flagged as a REPLACE candidate.
custom_justification: Not applicable.
notes: LAB-07.

rationale: Structure generation is a large content and worldgen problem best left to maintained packs, used sparingly.
custom_justification: Not applicable.
notes: LAB-11. ADR 0015 keeps worldgen conservative. Do not stack overlapping structure packs.

rationale: Contextual threat profiles are a pack design, not a mob-stat change, and ADR 0030 forbids global enemy scaling.
existing_mod_candidate: Dangerous structure packs for the sites themselves
companion_role: Threat profile selection and expedition state.
custom_justification: No maintained mod provides contextual, telegraphed danger without global scaling.
notes: LAB-11. Document before implementing.

rationale: A skill UI is presentation, and a generic skill-tree UI was flagged as a REPLACE candidate in the pivot.
companion_role: Feeding pack progression into the chosen framework.
custom_justification: Only the progression rules are pack-specific, not the interface.
notes: LAB-08.

rationale: One Focus plus two Supporting slots with permanent progress and free switching is a specific design that ADR 0004 fixes.
custom_justification: Generic action-XP skill systems are explicitly rejected; the rules are the design.
notes: Existing prototype code implements this and is a KEEP candidate pending LAB-08.

rationale: Normalizing a third-party datapack's private identifiers behind an adapter is exactly the connective work a companion mod exists for.
companion_role: Detection, translation, and safe no-op fallback.
custom_justification: ADR 0002 and principle 13 require isolation; no mod can do this for us.
notes: Already implemented and verified. Strong KEEP.

rationale: Items becoming broken rather than deleted is a pack-identity rule that interacts with every tool mod.
existing_mod_candidate: Possibly a smithing overhaul for repair UI
custom_justification: Principle 5 forbids deletion at zero durability; no general mod guarantees this across mods.
notes: LAB-09 must check Mending and smithing conflicts.

rationale: Field versus workshop repair and reforging are pack rules; the UI may come from a third-party smithing mod.
custom_justification: ADR 0006 defines a specific model no maintained mod implements.
notes: LAB-09.

rationale: Free-form settlement registration that evaluates function rather than style is the pack's central identity system. MineColonies-style mandatory blueprints are explicitly rejected.
custom_justification: No maintained mod offers style-free functional settlement validation. ADR 0009 defines settlements as building graphs, not circles or blueprints.
notes: Prototype domain models are KEEP candidates. Gameplay not implemented this run.

rationale: Career and institutional progression build on villagers rather than replacing them. Total identity-replacement mods are rejected.
existing_mod_candidate: Villager API or equivalent for hooks
companion_role: Career state, ranks, teaching, and institutional memory.
custom_justification: ADR 0007 and the career design are pack-specific; MCA-style replacement is explicitly out.
notes: LAB-10.

rationale: Cross-mod economic behaviour and the hybrid Obol currency depend on how this pack combines trade, settlements, and shops.
custom_justification: ADR 0008 and ADR 0017 define behaviour no general economy mod provides.
notes: Existing prototype code is a KEEP candidate.

rationale: Discovery consequences connect exploration to settlements, professions, and knowledge, which is inherently cross-system.
custom_justification: docs/design/adventure-reward-policy.md defines a model no mod implements.
notes: Depends on the knowledge system.

rationale: Route-gated travel is a pack rule. Unrestricted teleport networks are explicitly rejected as the core solution.
companion_role: Route registration, validation, and journey skipping.
custom_justification: ADR 0031 requires discovery, physical travel, infrastructure, and validation before skipping.
notes: Not a waystone mod.

rationale: World history is a record of this pack's own systems and cannot come from elsewhere.
custom_justification: Nothing external knows what this pack considers historically significant.

rationale: Blueprints are optional content shipped separately, never a gameplay requirement.
existing_mod_candidate: Litematica or schematic formats for the file layer
custom_justification: ADR 0032 keeps blueprints optional and style-independent.
notes: Licensing matters: do not redistribute community schematics without permission.

rationale: Performance mods are specialised, heavily tested, and must never be reimplemented.
custom_justification: Not applicable.
notes: LAB-10 is evaluating Lithium, FerriteCore, ImmediatelyFast, Entity Culling and spark. Sodium is client-side rendering and its 26.2 build is an alpha, so it is not eligible as a core dependency without a new decision.

rationale: One unified Field Journal replaces a pile of disconnected starter books. The individual viewers stay third-party.
existing_mod_candidate: Recipe viewer and Jade for the low-level tools
custom_justification: ADR 0029 requires a unified knowledge interface that no single mod provides for a mixed mod list.
notes: LAB-01 defines the requirements before any code.

rationale: Guaranteeing multiple routes to essential capabilities is a cross-cutting invariant over many mods.
custom_justification: No mod can enforce a multi-route guarantee across a curated mod list.
notes: docs/design/capability-web.csv is the design; enforcement comes later.
